evidence.title: Curious About Product Design? Start with EPC7!

name: Curious About Product Design? Start with EPC7!
summary: Closed Google Form for EPC7, a free 6-week foundational UI/UX training for beginners; registration ended 18 July 2026.
description: A Google Form (no longer accepting responses) that took applications for EPC7, the Enlightenment Program Cohort 7: a free 6-week foundational UI/UX training for beginners who want to understand product design before committing to a full bootcamp. The link now redirects to a notice that registration closed.
